description: This header file declares functions, constants, and data structures related to the Throttle Position Sensor (TPS) in a vehicle's firmware, including sensor status checks, value conversions, and rate of change calculations.

classes.name: tps_roc_s
classes.description: Structure holding TPS rate-of-change data, including previous and current time and value, as well as rate of change.

methods.name: hasPedalPositionSensor
methods.description: Checks if a pedal position sensor is available.

methods.name: getPedalPosition
methods.description: Returns the current pedal position as a percentage.

methods.name: getTPS
methods.description: Returns the current Throttle Position Sensor (TPS) position as a percentage of Wide Open Throttle (WOT).

methods.name: hasTpsSensor
methods.description: Checks if a TPS sensor is present.

methods.name: convertVoltageTo10bitADC
methods.description: Converts a voltage reading to a 10-bit ADC value.

methods.name: getTPS12bitAdc
methods.description: Returns the TPS sensor reading in a 12-bit ADC value.

methods.name: getTpsValue
methods.description: Calculates TPS percentage value from ADC reading.

methods.name: setBosch0280750009
methods.description: Sets the TPS to a specific Bosch sensor model.

methods.name: setMockTpsPosition
methods.description: Mocks a TPS position, typically for testing.

methods.name: setMockPedalPosition
methods.description: Mocks a pedal position, typically for testing.

methods.name: getTpsRateOfChange
methods.description: Returns the rate of change of the TPS.
